# 2025 Table

This chapter creates a descriptive table that shows the demographics of households with children exposed to guns in the home in 2025. 

**Input**

-   DemographyGunOwners/data/clean/gs-child.rds

**Output**

-   DemographyGunOwners/output

**Last ran**

-   `r format(Sys.Date(), format = "%A, %B %d, %Y")`

```{r, message = FALSE, warning = FALSE}
packages <-
  c(
    "tidyverse",
    "purrr",
    "haven",
    "survey",
    "tidyr",
    "gtsummary",
    "janitor",
    "dplyr",
    "here",
    "vtable",
    "tidycensus"
  )

pacman::p_load(packages, character.only = TRUE)

```

## Load data

```{r}
child <- 
  read_rds(
    here(
      path_od,
      "data",
      "clean", 
      "gs-child.rds"
      )
    )
```

## Filter to 2025

```{r}
child2025 <-
  child %>% 
  filter(year == 2025)

```


## Survey designs

```{r}
ds <- svydesign(
  ~1,
  data    = child,
  strata  = ~year,
  weights = ~weight
)
```
